title: Thai-Style Cod Fish Cakes with Green Beans and Sweet Chilli Dip
summary: Fragrant Thai-inspired cod fish cakes flecked with green beans, chilli, ginger and coriander, pan-fried until golden and served with a quick sweet chilli-lime dip. A light but satisfying pescatarian dinner with bright heat and fresh herbs.

ingredients.name: cod fillet, skinless and boneless, roughly chopped
red chilli, deseeded and finely chopped
lime, cut into wedges to serve

steps: Blanch the sliced green beans in boiling water for 1 minute, then drain and rinse under cold water. Pat dry so they do not make the fish cake mixture watery.

Put the chopped cod in a food processor with the ginger, garlic, egg, fish sauce, 1 tablespoon lime juice, cornstarch and salt. Pulse until the fish is finely minced and sticky, but not completely smooth.
Scrape the mixture into a bowl and fold in the green beans, spring onions, coriander and chopped chilli. Chill for 10 minutes to firm up.
Meanwhile, make the dip by stirring together the sriracha, honey, rice vinegar and the remaining 1 tablespoon lime juice until glossy and pourable.
With damp hands, shape the fish mixture into 12 small patties, about 1.5 cm thick.

Heat the vegetable oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Fry the fish cakes for 3–4 minutes on each side, in batches if needed, until deep golden outside and cooked through in the centre.
Drain briefly on kitchen paper, then serve hot with the sweet chilli dip and lime wedges.
